title: Thai Fish Cakes with Crunchy Topping
description: A delicious and flavorful Thai-inspired dish made with fish cakes and a crunchy topping. Serve as an appetizer or snack.

ingredients.name: thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: make sure to store in fridge

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.notes: make sure to store in fridge

instructions: Heat some oil in a pan and add the thai red curry paste.
Add the quaint fish and cook until it's opaque.
Add the coconut milk and cook until the mixture thickens.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and let it cool.
Add the toasted crunchy rice, deep-fried jeen, and toasted kanom to the bowl.
Mix well until everything is combined.
Pan-fry the patties until they're golden brown.
Serve with chopped cilantro on top.
